items.title: Graphs and Charts for Presenting Results (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Graphs and Charts for Presenting Results' under topic 7.5 (PDF 101, printed 97).

blocks.text: Hypothesis testing ke nataij pesh karne ke liye graphs aur charts aam tools hain. Bar charts categories ya groups ka muqabla karne ke liye achhe hain. Line graphs waqt ke saath trends aur tabdeeliyan dikhate hain. Pie charts hisse (proportions) aur feesad (percentages) dikhate hain. Scatter plots do variables ka rishta dikhate hain. Yeh tools nataij ko zyada dilchasp, wazeh aur samajhne mein aasan banate hain (Figure 7.2).
